changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0079. Staff onboarding wizard fields: employment details, invitation statuses, multi-branch access, and optional user permission overrides. Seats stay on SubscriptionSeats. Index review: UX employee code already unique per tenant; IX_StaffBranchAccess_TenantId_UserId supports branch lists; UX_UserPermissionOverrides stops duplicate grants. Performance note: filtered unique indexes keep soft-deleted rows out of lookups. Branch scope is added for authorized branch data access.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE app.StaffProfiles DROP CONSTRAINT CK_StaffProfiles_Status; ALTER TABLE app.StaffProfiles ADD CONSTRAINT CK_StaffProfiles_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Draft', N'PendingInvitation', N'Active', N'Suspended', N'Inactive'));
ALTER TABLE app.StaffProfiles ADD Designation NVARCHAR(120) NULL, Department NVARCHAR(120) NULL, EmploymentType NVARCHAR(32) NULL, ReportingManagerUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, EmploymentNotes NVARCHAR(2000) NULL, JobDescription NVARCHAR(2000) NULL, DateOfBirth DATE NULL, Gender NVARCHAR(32) NULL, Address NVARCHAR(300) NULL, EmergencyContactName NVARCHAR(200) NULL, EmergencyContactPhone NVARCHAR(32) NULL;
